name: dahlia-web
description: DAHLIA Housing Portal - Node/TS primary web server (TanStack Start)

RAILS_API_BASE_URL.description: Internal URL of the Rails Salesforce proxy Heroku app (e.g., https://dahlia-salesforce-proxy.herokuapp.com)

INTERNAL_API_KEY.description: Shared secret for Node→Rails proxy authentication

CLERK_SECRET_KEY.description: Clerk secret key for server-side auth

CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Clerk publishable key for client-side auth

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL (auto-set by Heroku add-on)

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL (auto-set by Heroku add-on)
